rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: In the presence of Defence Minister Anatoly Serdyukov, control of Russia's strategic nuclear forces is transferred to the President of Russia and Supreme Commander-in-Chief Dmitry Medvedev, who receives the report of the duty-shift officers.
rows.locator: Heading and both paragraphs (7 May 2008, 15:15, Moscow, Kremlin)
